findings.title: Netlify measured as closest competitor
findings.evidence_anchor: Netlify as the audited brand's closest measured competitor with measured distance 0.855
findings.observation: A snapshot comparison of 5 competitors identifies Netlify as the closest measured competitor to the audited brand, with a distance of 0.855 compared to an average distance of 0.873.
findings.bounded_interpretation: The audited brand's positioning shares the most similarities with Netlify among the analyzed set.
findings.limits: Does not prove superiority, product quality, adoption, customer choice, durable defensibility, or planning direction.

findings.title: Brand identity creation for indie developers
findings.evidence_anchor: "Iris creates complete brand identities for indie developers in minutes—with the strategic thinking that makes agencies charge $40k." (https://irisdesign.dev/)
findings.observation: The audited surface states the service creates brand identities for indie developers in minutes and compares its strategic thinking to agencies charging $40k.
findings.bounded_interpretation: The messaging positions the service as a rapid alternative to traditional agency brand identity creation, specifically targeting indie developers.
findings.limits: Does not prove actual cost, quality of strategic thinking, adoption by indie developers, or actual time taken to create identities.

findings.title: Owned design infrastructure positioning
findings.evidence_anchor: "Building the design infrastructure for modern startups." (https://watermelon.sh/)

findings.bounded_interpretation: If this messaging represents their primary market stance, the entity positions its offerings around design infrastructure specifically targeted at startup organizations.
